assumptions: The supplied API accepts CSS selectors against the currently open listing and resolves discovered anchor URLs.
Book detail pages have catalogue paths ending in a numeric book identifier and index.html.
Scroll result links are newly revealed or currently observed links; retaining all observed candidates is safe.
api.save reports whether a page was saved and leaves the browser on that detail page.
reason: The observed listing uses product_pod articles with anchors around each book image and title. Collecting from those cards and scroll results accommodates a different starting listing while excluding navigation links, and bounded scrolling prioritizes revealed candidates. The initial representative detail is skipped through exclude_urls.
